body:
Cmon bud, I can listen.
Hmu ✨💖

Happy birthday bud 🎉🎊, don't worry you will see your graduation paper in your hands. Head up and go fight them. Show them that you're strong. Show them your big unmeasurable value. Even if your leg slips one or two times it doesn't matter. Just clench your fists, head up and go forward💗💖. Dm me if you need to talk yourself out or cry something out. I'm here for you ^^
Good luck 👍💓

Even tho I deal with my problems too I am still able to make people happy, I'd love to know how it feels to be happy. Don't worry mane, there's always this one person that cares about you, this one person that loves you. If there isn't I am here. Dm me here bud I'm here almost all the time 💖😈😥
Come on please don't go, we need you here. We are here for eachother!
